title: Firestorm
justification: TVDB 150781 is gone and no TVDB series or movie carries this 2003 26-episode TV series: TheTVDB search for Firestorm finds only unrelated live-action films and shows, and nothing for ファイアーストーム; SkyHook finds nothing either, and AniList 2382 lists no related anime. A TV series with no TVDB entry takes the marker other. TMDB 26016 season 1 lists the 26 AniDB episodes from Storm Force 9 (2003-04-06), so the TMDB values stay.
